text:
maria: Quick sync — I put a proposed acceptance checklist + minimal runbook for the observability console MVP. We need to lock scope by EOD so eng can cut the branch.
ashok: Can you paste the checklist here? I want to verify tracing hook coverage for hot paths.
maria: Sure — high level first, then gaps I see:

1) Dashboards: customer-facing per-route token/cost breakdown, per-model latency p95/p99, and a small "errors by class" panel.
2) Tracing hooks: request->model trace with span for routing decision, queueing, model exec. Sampling 1% default + on-demand capture for specific trace IDs.
3) Cost breakdown: token attribution to model variant + cache hits vs compute cost estimate.
4) Error analytics: automatic grouping for 5xx, model-timeout, parse-errors, and a simple root-cause tagger for prompt vs model.
5) Rollout gating: canary for 10% traffic, automatic fallback to hosted small model on high-error/latency.

Runbook excerpt: recovery steps for a broken trace pipeline, who to page, and a disposable dashboard to validate dataflow.

Notes: this is intentionally small; no long-tail instrumentation or full trace sampling in the MVP.

ashok: From eng — OK on the tracing span set, except we need to add KV-cache hit/miss spans. Otherwise fine.
julia: Agree with +kv spans. Also, dashboards: can we avoid heavy aggregations at ingest? Keep rollups daily to start.
kevin: SLO ask: add alert when p99 latency > 1.5x target for 5m and when error rate increases 3x baseline. Who owns these alerts initially?
liz: CS: customers asked specifically for per-model cost comparisons and an "explain cost" drilldown. If we don't ship it MVP, we need a public note and a workaround.
maria: Good call. Proposal: include per-model cost comparison panel (top 5 models + historical) but mark deep drilldown as post-MVP. That keeps visibility for CS.
julia: Implementation detail — per-request cost attribution requires adding a small header in request path with model_id and token_count. We can annotate logs and surface in the dashboard via the ingestion pipeline. That adds ~1 engineer-week.
ashok: One customer ask to see tracing for reranking pipeline specifically. Can we add a small config toggle to capture those traces at 100% for an org?\e kevin: (typo) — kevin: Yes, we can gate capture by org_id for a short window. Need to ensure PII scrubber runs first.
liz: Also flag: enterprise customers will ask for longer retention (90d). Not in MVP but need pricing/plan note.
maria: Tradeoffs for scope lock:
- In: per-model cost comparison (summary), p95/p99 latency, error-class panels, basic request->model traces, canary rollout with fallback.
- Out: full trace retention >30d, detailed per-token cost drilldown, advanced root-cause ML (post-MVP).

maria: Acceptance criteria (concrete):
- Dashboards render for prod + staging with under 2s first-load for top queries.
- Traces exist and link from a sample request in dashboard -> trace view.
- Cost panel shows last 7 days by model and matches billing sample for three test customers within 5%.
- Runbook: documented three-step recovery + oncall pager and a postmortem template.

kevin: Ops acceptance: also need documented query limits and a mitigation plan if dashboard queries spike (rate limiter config).
julia: I'll add the rate limiter config to the PR. I estimate 1.5 engineer-weeks total to hit these acceptance criteria (traces + panels + limited runbook).
ashok: Timeline reality check: if we lock today, we can aim for a beta release in 3 sprints, GA in 6, assuming no big infra blockers.

liz: CS asks that we provide a short "what's missing" doc to customers if we ship the MVP. I can draft that once scope is locked.
maria: OK — final asks before I lock: @julia confirm KV-cache span + rate limiter, @kevin confirm alert thresholds and retention baseline (30d), @liz confirm CS messaging. Reply by EOD.
julia: Confirmed KV-cache span + rate limiter config. Will PR by tomorrow morning.
kevin: Confirmed alerts and retention baseline 30d. Pager rotation included.
liz: I'll draft the customer note and sample FAQ.
maria: Great — locking scope at 18:00 PST unless somebody objects. If any red-lines, drop them here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch observability/mvp-checklist -> staging (CI green).
maria: Thanks team — will post final checklist + link to runbook in the repo after lock.
